title: atlas.submission.read.v1 — result
description: Look up a submission by id or by the idempotency key you used. This exists for the case that matters: your connection dropped after you sent a proposal and you do not know whether it committed. Retrying blind is only safe while the key is still within the published idempotency window.

anyOf.description: When this key stops being deduplicated. After it, an identical retry commits a SECOND copy. null means the receipt has already expired.
